summary.text: Simon Glaser is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Nels Pierson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an educator of more than 30 years who later served as a union leader.

paragraphs.text: Glaser earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1992 and a graduate degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 1996, and Ballotpedia lists English teacher among his career experience.
Glaser named lowering the cost of living, stopping fraud and fixing the health care system as his three key campaign messages.

He said he is passionate about public education and labor rights and listed endorsements from the MN AFL-CIO, Education Minnesota, AFSCME Councils 5 and 65, IBEW Local 343 and Teamsters Joint Council 32, among others.
